title: SAT is NP-complete
statement: The language of binary strings whose total CNF decoding is satisfiable belongs to NP, and every language in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to it.
replaced: The language $\mathrm{SAT}$ of serialized satisfiable CNF formulas is $\mathrm{NP}$-complete: it belongs to $\mathrm{NP}$ and every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ polynomial-time many-one reduces to it.
